evals.prompt: The working tree mixes a refactor, a bug fix, and a new feature. Turn it into a clean history.
evals.expected_output: Separate atomic commits with clear messages, each independently green
expectations: Refactor, fix, and feature land as separate commits
Commit messages are imperative and standalone
Each commit leaves the tree in a working state

evals.prompt: Run python3 completed-work-fixture.py to create a contained synthetic project. Read completed-example/repo/AGENTS.md and the completed-work reference. Export implementation is already integrated and accepted complete; Import remains active. Preserve only Export’s untracked worktree-local SPEC.md, SPEC-export.md, tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md in the canonical vault/spec-history/ with descriptive, flat names. Repair their internal links and add a readable history link in vault/status.md. Verify archival contents before safely removing only repo/.worktrees/feature-export and its integrated local feature/export branch. Preserve the active Import worktree and its local documents, all primary-checkout tracked files, all existing human-facing Export/Import pages, their evidence and the earlier archived record. The sole permitted vault changes are the new archived task documents and their status link. This request authorizes spec-history and the contained fixture setup, not main-tree document copies, extra directories, a commit, merge, network, force, installation or runtime changes. Verify against completed-example/original.json and distinguish this synthetic proof from a real app build.
evals.expected_output: Accepted merged task records are preserved in Obsidian spec-history before ordinary worktree cleanup, while main contains no task specs/plans and active work is preserved.
expectations: Archives all four Export task documents as descriptively named flat Markdown files in vault/spec-history/, preserving substantive content with valid internal links, and updates vault/status.md to an existing archived spec
Leaves the primary checkout tracked files byte-identical and with no task-spec or task-plan additions or new commits; does not use repo/done/ or tasks/done/
Preserves the active feature/import worktree and all its documents, the earlier spec-history record and all existing human-facing vault pages/evidence byte-identical

Verifies clean tracked state and merged ancestry, verifies archival contents before ordinary removal of only feature-export and safe local branch deletion, uses no force or remote operations, and identifies the proof as synthetic
